info.name: ShipIt API (Modules 1-7)
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for ShipIt backend, including Module 1 (Authentication & User Management), Module 2 (GitHub App Integration & Webhooks), Module 3 (Project Management & Encrypted Environment Variables), Module 4 (Deployment Management & Lifecycles), Module 5 (Background Job Engine & Worker Polling), Module 6 (Build Engine & Containerization), and Module 7 (Container Deployment Engine & Lifecycle Controls).

request.description: Registers a new user account and returns JWT tokens.

request.description: Logs in with email and password, returning short-lived accessToken and rotating refreshToken.
Performs atomic refresh token rotation with reuse detection.
Revokes the active refresh token session.
Fetches authenticated user details (id, name, email, role, status).
Lists external OAuth identities linked to this user.
Generates a cryptographically random CSRF state token (stored as SHA-256 in DB) and returns the GitHub App installation URL.
Simulates or executes the callback after GitHub App installation. Validates CSRF state atomically and persists connection in PENDING_VERIFICATION status.

exec: console.log('Set connectionId from first item:', json.data[0].id);

request.description: Lists all active/pending GitHub App connections for the authenticated user.
Gets details of a specific GitHub App connection.
Triggers server-to-server verification with GitHub using RS256 App JWT. Populates installation metadata (accountLogin, accountType, repoSelection, permissions) and transitions status to CONNECTED.
Locally disconnects the GitHub App installation, setting status to DISCONNECTED and evicting cached tokens.
Lists repositories accessible to this GitHub App installation directly from the GitHub API using a short-lived token.
Previews branches from GitHub for an accessible repository before connecting/importing it.
Connects and imports a repository into ShipIt, saving its metadata (fullName, cloneUrl, defaultBranch, isPrivate) in PostgreSQL.
Lists all repositories tracked and connected by the authenticated user.
Retrieves metadata of a specific connected repository.
Lists branches for a connected repository using the active GitHub connection.
Unlinks/disconnects the repository from ShipIt.
Simulates GitHub sending a ping event when a webhook is first configured.
Simulates GitHub delivering a push event for connected repository rohit2143/ShipIt.
Simulates GitHub delivering a branch deletion event, which ShipIt safely acknowledges and ignores.
Simulates a push to an unconnected repository; ShipIt returns 200 OK and marks delivery as IGNORED.

item.name: 2. Create Project (With Initial Encrypted Env Vars)

request.description: Creates a Project with initial environment variables, encrypting secrets at rest with AES-256-GCM + AAD.
Lists all projects owned by the authenticated user with repository summary metadata.
Retrieves full configuration details and environment variable count for a specific project.

request.description: Updates project build/start configuration, port, or branch.
Deletes project and cascades deletion to all associated environment variables.
Lists all environment variables for a project. Secret variables are masked as '********'.
Retrieves a single environment variable by key (masked if secret).
Upserts an environment variable. If isSecret=true, encrypts with AES-256-GCM bound to (projectId, key) via AAD.
Atomically batch upserts multiple environment variables with duplicate key validation and secret encryption.
Deletes an environment variable by key.
Triggers a manual deployment for an active project. Optional branch, commitSha, and commitMessage.
Lists paginated deployment history for a project, sorted by createdAt DESC.
Retrieves full configuration, status, timestamps, and duration for a specific deployment.
Safely cancels a queued or cloning deployment. Rejects cancellation of terminal or active builds.
Retries a failed or cancelled deployment by creating a new QUEUED deployment with trigger=RETRY.

item.name: 5. Background Jobs (Module 5)

request.description: Retrieves the latest background execution job for the specified deployment. Automatically saves the job ID to the collection variable {{jobId}}.
Retrieves detailed execution metrics, status, worker node, priority, retry counters, and duration for a specific job.
Lists all background execution jobs associated with the deployment, ordered newest first.
Retrieves real-time counts of background jobs across all statuses (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED) and total jobs queued.

item.description: Endpoints for inspecting database-backed asynchronous background jobs, monitoring execution states, and tracking queue statistics.

item.name: 6. Build Engine (Module 6)

request.description: Retrieves real-time or historical build stdout/stderr execution logs for the specified deployment.

item.description: Endpoints for retrieving Docker build logs, compiler output, and project packaging diagnostics.

item.name: 7. Container Deployment Engine (Module 7)

request.description: Inspects the live state, health probe, host port mapping, and metadata of the Docker container running for this deployment.
Restarts the running Docker container for the specified deployment.
Stops the active Docker container for the specified deployment gracefully.

query.description: Number of tail log lines to retrieve (default: 100, max: 2000)

request.description: Fetches live stdout/stderr logs from the active Docker container running for this deployment.

item.description: Endpoints for inspecting live container runtime state, graceful stop, restart, and reading container stdout/stderr logs.

item.name: 8. Deployment Logs & Streaming (Module 8)

request.description: Subscribes to real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) log stream for the deployment terminal.

query.description: Optional execution stage filter (CLONING, DETECTING, BUILDING, STARTING, HEALTH_CHECKING, CONTAINER, SYSTEM)
Optional cursor: only return logs strictly after this sequence number

request.description: Retrieves paginated, structured historical deployment logs with stage and sequence-based filtering.
Downloads the complete formatted execution log file for this deployment.

item.description: Endpoints for real-time Server-Sent Events log streaming, structured historical log queries, and raw log file downloads.
